name: London startup generalist rebuilding a search after closure

context.occupation: Startup operations generalist targeting Chief of Staff and BizOps
context.employment_state: Previous startup closed; actively seeking next role
constraints: Wants to understand employer stability without false assurances
context.company_awareness: Aware of the startup ecosystem but building a new employer shortlist

trigger: After the employer closes, searches for equivalent work but sees the same title applied to administration, AI-training projects and strategic operating roles.

searches_run.query: Chief of Staff BizOps startup jobs London
searches_run.observation: Retrieval returned specialist boards, founder-support jobs, recruiting programs and AI-training expert opportunities. One direct startup vacancy URL returned 404 on opening. Similar titles therefore did not establish comparable employment or current availability.

searches_run.query: startup job candidate questions funding runway chief of staff London early stage
searches_run.observation: Results mixed interview content, recruiting claims about funding/runway and an investor-authored hiring guide. Direct Outset inspection describes the role as variable, lists adjacent titles and encourages publishing founder/funding specifics; it does not validate any startup's current finances.

sources.title: Chief of Staff and BizOps jobs — BizOps Network
sources.supports: Retrieved specialist source groups Chief of Staff and operations opportunities; no accuracy or market-volume claim.

sources.title: Expert Opportunity Chief of Staff / Business Operations Lead — Ethos
sources.supports: Retrieved description concerns helping train an AI model, not necessarily becoming an operating leader in a startup.

sources.title: Chief of Staff to CEO — Cassi
sources.supports: Retrieved startup role described operations duties and an uncertain Oxford/London office; direct open returned 404, so no current vacancy is claimed.

sources.title: Guide to hiring a Chief of Staff — Outset Capital
sources.supports: Direct investor-authored guide describes variable scope, suggests founder/funding specifics and enumerates adjacent operations titles. It is advice, not company financial verification.

best_entry_page.primary_query: Chief of Staff vs BizOps startup jobs London
best_entry_page.promise: Map overlapping operating titles to responsibilities and show how to assemble a dated employer shortlist with stage and funding claims clearly attributed.
best_entry_page.cta: Compare role scope and research the employer
proof_needed: Examples of actual responsibilities across titles
Verified coverage of small London startups
Dated primary funding announcements when discussing rounds
Funding amount not treated as current runway or safety
Exclude AI-training tasks from conventional employment comparisons unless labeled
New indexable guide; company/search pages are noindex

conversion_objections: Do you cover small companies before they become well-known?
Does Chief of Staff mean operational ownership or mostly executive assistance?
Is this an actual operating job or an expert contractor task?
How old is the funding information?
Can I search across adjacent titles without drowning in unrelated operations jobs?

avoid_targeting.query: safe startup jobs guaranteed funding runway
avoid_targeting.reason: No stability guarantee or private financial verification exists.
Financial/investment advice is outside this job-search use case.

avoid_targeting.query: Chief of Staff AI training tasks
avoid_targeting.reason: A different work model from the persona's target operating role.

message_to_founder: Simulation: I want to join another early-stage team, but I will ask harder questions after the last company closed. Help me compare the actual work across titles and show where company-stage information came from, without pretending funding guarantees stability.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic persona, exactly two queries, one failed employer open and one successful investor-guide inspection. Other queries are hypotheses. No employer funding, runway, stability or job availability independently verified. Funding/stage filters are not demonstrated; company-first discovery helps only after useful employer research.
